search: PUCT MCTS; per-config priors; exploration 1.5; reached-subtree reuse; maximum visits root choice
limits: Paired colors and shared seeds from the initial board; repeated paths possible. No Elo inference.
elapsedPolicy: Sum of recorded segment runtimes, excluding interruption downtime and discarded partial game

publication.normalization: Only model/manifest paths made repository-relative; records, timings, resume history and source hashes unchanged
